title: Why NO sloped Panzer IV?
author: Military History Visualized
shortDescription:
Play War Thunder for free and get a nice bonus pack with vehicles, premium time and more: https://playwt.link/militaryhistoryvisualized 
Check out War Thunder’s new mobile version on iOS and Android: https://wtm.game/militaryhistoryvisualized

Why didn't the Germans upgrade their Panzer IV to have a sloped frontal armor? There were actually plans for this, the original Panzer IV Ausführung H, the question is why was it cancelled? What were the reasons.
